summary: Rio Tinto filed a routine Form 6-K covering October 2026 London Stock Exchange disclosures. Exhibits include a Total Voting Rights and Issued Capital notice showing 1,256,051,053 ordinary shares with total voting rights of 1,255,183,664, share issuance and Appendix 3G/3H notices, PDMR/KMP shareholding updates, and Form 603/605 substantial-holder notices. Two media releases cover a $1.9 billion Kangwinan bauxite investment in Queensland and $1.4 billion of Argentine lithium projects. No special situation; monitoring hinges on ordinary capital-return and PDMR flows rather than deal terms.
